policies: Prefer HTTPS over HTTP for external traffic.
Prefer SFTP or FTPS over FTP for file transfer.
Use SMTP/IMAP/POP3 only with TLS where possible.
Use API keys, OAuth, mTLS, or signed tokens where applicable.
No private system connection without authorization.
No credentials or tokens in Git.
Log protocol access through audit trail.
Human approval required for high-impact integrations.
